# ML Graph Compiler

> A deep learning graph compiler: ONNX in, optimized C out.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg

## Source

- [src/ml_graph_compiler/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/__init__.py): ml-graph-compiler: ONNX import, SSA graph IR, optimization passes and code generation.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/cli.py): Command line interface: ``python -m ml_graph_compiler`` or ``mgc``.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/codegen/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/codegen/__init__.py): C code generation backend: emitter, build driver and ctypes runtime.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/codegen/build.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/codegen/build.py): Compile generated C into a shared library with the system C compiler.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/codegen/c.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/codegen/c.py): C code generation.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/codegen/runtime_lib.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/codegen/runtime_lib.py): Load and run a compiled model through ctypes.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/errors.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/errors.py): Exception types raised by the compiler.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/interpreter.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/interpreter.py): Reference interpreter: executes the IR with the numpy semantics in :mod:`ops`.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/ir.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/ir.py): Graph intermediate representation in static single assignment form.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/memory.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/memory.py): Static memory planning: liveness, aliasing, in-place reuse and offset assignment.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/mlir/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/mlir/__init__.py): MLIR textual export and an optional MLIR execution path.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/mlir/emit.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/mlir/emit.py): Print a graph as MLIR text (see the package docstring for the two forms).
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/mlir/execute.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/mlir/execute.py): Verify, lower and run exported MLIR with the LLVM tools (mlir-opt, mlir-translate, clang).
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/onnx_import.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/onnx_import.py): ONNX model importer: protobuf graph to the SSA IR, with static shapes.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/ops.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/ops.py): Operator registry: shape and type inference plus numpy reference semantics.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/passes/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/passes/__init__.py): Optimization passes and the pass manager.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/passes/basic.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/passes/basic.py): Constant folding, dead code elimination and common subexpression elimination.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/passes/fusion.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/passes/fusion.py): Operator fusion.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/passes/layout.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/passes/layout.py): Layout transformation: NCHW convolution and pooling regions to NHWC.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/passes/loopfuse.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/passes/loopfuse.py): Loop fusion: chains of elementwise operators become one FusedElementwise node.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/passes/simplify.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/passes/simplify.py): Algebraic simplification and canonicalization.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/passes/util.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/passes/util.py): Helpers shared by the optimization passes.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/samples.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/samples.py): Small ONNX models built with ``onnx.helper`` for tests, demos and smoke checks.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/schedule.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/schedule.py): Operator scheduling: memory-aware list scheduling and dataflow (wavefront) analysis.
- [src/ml_graph_compiler/shape_inference.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ml-graph-compiler-hyg/blob/main/src/ml_graph_compiler/shape_inference.py): Static shape and type inference with partial evaluation of small shape computations.
